title: Binary Search
tip: Write the loop bounds without an off-by-one. Say the invariant.
statement: Given a sorted array of integers `nums` (ascending, distinct) and an integer `target`, return the index of `target` or `-1` if it is not present. You must write an algorithm with O(log n) runtime.
constraints: All integers in nums are unique.
nums is sorted in ascending order.
editorial: lo, hi inclusive or exclusive — pick one and stick to it. Mid overflow: lo + (hi-lo)//2.
